headline: What's Going On With Netflix Stock Tuesday?
summary: Netflix shares are trading higher Tuesday morning as deal chatter lingers after Monday's slide to fresh 52-week low on M&A concerns.

headline: Netflix Stock Plunges To 20-Month Low: Can Live Sports Replace ‘Stranger Things’ And ‘Squid Game’?
summary: The most successful shows on Netflix have wrapped. The company is now exploring new strategies to keep subscribers and gain new ones.
